Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "12 x 0.8 should be less than 12" ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Hints: A positive number multiplied by a positive fraction below one becomes smaller.
Solution: 12 = 12/1; 0.8 = 8/10. Multiply: 12 × 8 = 96; denominator 1 × 10 = 10. So 12 × 0.8 = 96/10 = 9.6. Therefore the requested answer is TRUE.
